title: Exact constant realization on derived module categories
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site with topology $J$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and let $R$ be a commutative ring. Write $\underline R$ for the constant ring sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Use module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], with independently chosen localization morphism universes. The constant module functor $c_J:\operatorname{Mod}(R)\to\operatorname{Mod}(\underline R)$ of [def-sf-site-constant-module-functor], obtained by sheafifying the constant module presheaf, is additive and exact. Define the derived constant realization $\underline{(-)}:D(R)\to D(\mathcal C,\underline R)$ to be the functor induced by applying $c_J$ termwise to cochain complexes and descending at quasi-isomorphisms by the exact-functor localization construction. Thus its representative comparison is the canonical factorization $Q\circ C(c_J)\cong\underline{(-)}\circ Q$. No boundedness or finiteness is imposed on the complexes. The site object and morphism universes are independent and the coefficient universe contains both.
